description: This PHP class 'FormatWithDate' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to provide a method for formatting DateTime objects as 'Y-m-d' string format. It is part of the OrangeHRM Maintenance module and is used for formatting date values in the context of access strategy and format value processing.

classes.name: FormatWithDate
classes.description: A class that formats DateTime objects into 'Y-m-d' string format.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Formats the given DateTime entity value as a string in 'Y-m-d' format, or returns null if the value is not a DateTime instance.
